name: Open the newest case replay from the front page (signed in, v2)
description: Validates the front page (its heading, the live recorder card, the newest cases) and that the first case card opens that case's replay console with its 3D view drawn. It accepts both the home page and the landing page that replaces it.

planSteps.description: In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Assert the page heading (h1) reads either "Ship traffic over subsea cables" (the home page) or "Ships are crossing the world's cables right now." (the landing page)

Assert the live recorder card (data-testid recorder-status) is shown with a data-state of recording, failing, stale, never-ran or unreachable; unless it is unreachable, its ship count (data-testid recorder-ships) is a whole number
Assert the newest cases list (data-testid latest-cases) holds 1 or 2 case cards, each a link whose data-testid starts with case-card-
Note the slug in the data-testid of the first case card link in that list (case-card-<slug>), then click that link

Assert the URL path is /cases/<slug> for the noted slug, the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown, and the case switcher button (data-testid case-switcher) shows the case's title (not empty)
Then wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert no card saying "The 3D view did not load" is shown
